entities.name: 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context stored in UE and AMF for NAS security operations including integrity protection and ciphering.

entities.name: NAS security protection
entities.description: Procedures for security protection of NAS messages between UE and AMF, and protection of NAS IEs between UE and UDM. Includes integrity protection and ciphering.

entities.name: 5GMM message
entities.description: NAS messages that are directly security protected through integrity protection and ciphering.

entities.name: 5GSM message
entities.description: NAS session management messages that are indirectly protected by being piggybacked in security protected 5GMM messages.

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message that carries 5GSM messages and is security protected.

entities.name: DL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Downlink NAS transport message that carries 5GSM messages and is security protected.

entities.name: Null ciphering algorithm (5G-EA0)
entities.description: Ciphering algorithm that provides no encryption, used when ciphering is not required in the network.

entities.name: NAS security control procedures
entities.description: Signalling procedures for control of NAS security, part of the 5GMM protocol.

relations.description: 5GMM messages require security protection through integrity protection and ciphering.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message carries 5GSM messages as piggybacked content.
DL NAS TRANSPORT message carries 5GSM messages as piggybacked content.
5GSM messages are indirectly protected by being carried within security protected 5GMM messages.
NAS security control procedures include steps for NAS security protection.
When null ciphering algorithm is used, NAS messages may be transmitted without ciphering protection.
